about: Agent review policy read by .github/scripts/agent_policy_check.py from the base branch. Agents merge their own PRs; humans approve only the gates below, in words. See AGENTS.md 'Agent review and release policy'.
ownersRule: The top 3 committers to the default branch in the last 6 months who are current orbit-search members (bots excluded), plus NicholasDominici for backend and orbit repos. Refresh when people join or leave. Plus jonnybcw on every repo (Nicholas, 2026-10-22).
